title: Five Weapons
description: Five experimental weapon types in one isolated range: Foundry (heavy hand cannon), Sightline (scout rifle), Switchback (automatic carbine), Bulkhead (scattergun) and Mass Driver (charged kinetic). Keys 1-5 switch; 6 is Heavy Report as you played it, 0 the Static Pulse as it ships. Metal, concrete, organic and wood targets, a 40 HP target, a moving dummy and loose bodies to shove. No enemies. Offline: nothing of yours is saved or changed.
limitations: Guns are placeholder shapes; Arty's silhouettes and layered Glyph effects are pending.
Sounds are labelled placeholders until Condi's SigmAudio renders land (N mutes them).
